system.summary: Master Key: unlocks any door. Cursed: each use moves the Doom Clock forward 3 minutes and makes you Cursed.

automation.note: Master Key opens any door. While Cursed you can't heal or remove wounds from your Lifeline; the Curse ends only when the Keys are destroyed.
